title: [Bug] Unintended Opus Model Usage When Specifying Haiku for Subagent Task
body:
**Bug Description**
I asked it to spawn subagents with the Haiku model to translate my newly added keys to a json, but it used Opus and it just completely killed the Opus limit immediately. 

**Environment Info**

- Terminal: intellij
- Version: 1.0.112
